text:
你用 Codex 跑大项目的时候，token 其实有一大块是白烧的。

不是模型笨，是你喂给它的东西太脏了。

每次 git diff、git status、测试日志、cat 文件——这些命令输出里大半都是 Codex 根本不需要的内容。但每一行都在吃你的 token。

RTK（Rust Token Killer）就是干这件事的。

它在终端输出进入 Codex 之前，自动压缩掉冗余部分。官方数据：常见命令输出能砍掉 60-90%。

单次调用可能感觉不出来。但 Codex 在大项目里连续跑几个小时，不断读 diff、跑测试、看日志——累计省下的 token 非常可观。

本质上不是让 Codex 少干活。
是别让它把 token 烧在垃圾上下文上。

🔗链接：
https://t.co/oFlbIwSg79

text: @askmycindy 比较一下我和 Chris 的工作量，说一下我们分别在负责哪些领域，我们是如何靠 Cindy 来提升工作效率的。

quotedTweet.text:
这是个人用 Cindy 一周的工作量，还不包括 FiloMail 的工作量，这放在过去可能要带个 20-30 人团队做一个月的活儿，Cindy 帮我做到了😁，希望能帮助身边所有人都变成这种程度：

Cindy · Chris 近 7 日 PR（8/6–8/12）

共发起 43 个 PR，约 302 个提交；37 个已合并，4 个仍在审，2 个关闭未合并。

• Telegram 双 Bot 的消息、命令、交互卡和过程呈现逐步共用同一套核心。个人 Bot 补齐设置、离线消息时效、相册回退和隐私边界，官方 Bot 增加确认表情与完整进度。两套入口行为更一致，也更不容易重复发送或泄露受保护内容。

• Telegram 群消息支持全文持久化、分线程检索和按存储大小保留，不再因“最近 500 条”快速丢失历史。Agent 可以在权限限定的当前群和话题内查询“以前谁说过什么”，重启后游标也能延续。

• 本地 /review 成为跨 Claude Code、Codex、Pi 的正式能力，可隔离审查代码、文档、PDF 和图片。后续又修掉真实工作区过大、pnpm 双链接和托管 worktree 导致的启动失败与审错版本问题，Review 从实验功能变成了实际可用的成果复核入口。

• Auto Review 大幅减少误报，并开始记忆边界完全一致的安全操作，避免相同命令反复审核。今天新增的 #2474 还会在审阅服务波动时自动重试，失败后交还用户确认，并按模型能力分配额度，不再静默拒绝正常操作；该 PR 当前仍在审。

• Subagent 增加跨三套 Harness 的持久工作区，统一记录运行状态、模型、用量和结果，重启后仍能查看；同时修正 Codex 子代理 Token 虚高，并恢复对话卡就地展开、不强制弹出右栏的原有交互。

• 跨 Agent、模型和供应商的协作更完整：send_to_session 可以指定目标 Harness 与模型创建任务；Pi 补齐自定义 MCP、图片能力判断和角色说明；Codex 能恢复包含其他供应商历史的会话，ChatGPT 授权失效后也有真正有效的重新登录入口。

• 远程和多端体验得到补强：新任务可继承当前选中的远程机器，Android 宽屏切换任务不再崩溃或白屏；三套 Harness 统一展示回合速度与耗时，GitHub 官方插件还能安全复用本机 gh 登录，且并发 MCP Session 不再串上下文。

仍在审的 4 个：#2474 Auto Review 自愈、#2383 Telegram 终稿可靠投递、#2255 精确批准记忆、#1858 Pi 切换状态回显。

• Telegram 双 Bot 的消息、命令、交互卡和过程呈现逐步共用同一套核心。个人 Bot 补齐设置、离线消息时效、相册回退和隐私边界，官方 Bot 增加确认表情与完整进度。两套入口行为更一致，也更不容易重复发送或泄露受保护内容。

• Telegram 群消息支持全文持久化、分线程检索和按存储大小保留，不再因“最近 500 条”快速丢失历史。Agent 可以在权限限定的当前群和话题内查询“以前谁说过什么”，重启后游标也能延续。

• 本地 /review 成为跨 Claude Code、Codex、Pi 的正式能力，可隔离审查代码、文档、PDF 和图片。后续又修掉真实工作区过大、pnpm 双链接和托管 worktree 导致的启动失败与审错版本问题，Review 从实验功能变成了实际可用的成果复核入口。

• Auto Review 大幅减少误报，并开始记忆边界完全一致的安全操作，避免相同命令反复审核。今天新增的 #2474 还会在审阅服务波动时自动重试，失败后交还用户确认，并按模型能力分配额度，不再静默拒绝正常操作；该 PR 当前仍在审。

• Subagent 增加跨三套 Harness 的持久工作区，统一记录运行状态、模型、用量和结果，重启后仍能查看；同时修正 Codex 子代理 Token 虚高，并恢复对话卡就地展开、不强制弹出右栏的原有交互。

• 跨 Agent、模型和供应商的协作更完整：send_to_session 可以指定目标 Harness 与模型创建任务；Pi 补齐自定义 MCP、图片能力判断和角色说明；Codex 能恢复包含其他供应商历史的会话，ChatGPT 授权失效后也有真正有效的重新登录入口。

• 远程和多端体验得到补强：新任务可继承当前选中的远程机器，Android 宽屏切换任务不再崩溃或白屏；三套 Harness 统一展示回合速度与耗时，GitHub 官方插件还能安全复用本机 gh 登录，且并发 MCP Session 不再串上下文。

仍在审的 4 个：#2474 Auto Review 自愈、#2383 Telegram 终稿可靠投递、#2255 精确批准记忆、#1858 Pi 切换状态回显。

text:
😤WTF？！所以穷人孩子一直穷，富人孩子一直富？？

最近刷到个视频，一个亿万富翁，让十来岁的女儿当场打电话向陌生人推销，还真成交了，那份掌控感超过八成成年人。

这人叫 Grant Cardone，汽车销售出身，做成了亿万富翁，还上过一档综艺：隐去身份、只带 100 美金和一辆皮卡，90 天从零干出一家百万美元公司（Discovery 的《卧底亿万富翁》）。就那种把"搞钱"刻进骨子里的人。

后来他专门录了条1h视频，当面把整套财富思维一条条教给女儿。我全听完了，挑4个自己最有共鸣的和大家共勉：

一、听建议，只听比你强的人的。
他说这辈子踩的一个大坑，就是听了太多人的建议；回头复盘，真正有用的全来自比他更有结果的人。

这点我太有体感！你听菜鸡的建议，只能变成菜鸡；你听你爸的，顶多变成你爸。
同级朋友和没搞过钱的父母，能给你的就是他们认知的天花板，而那个天花板，大概率还没你高。

二、钱，跟着注意力走。
你东西做得再好，没人知道你，就没人买，市场没义务来发现你。他后来拼命做内容、上电视、搞播客，就是想明白了：不会传播的人只能一遍遍费力自证，攥着注意力的人机会自己找上门。
咱们搞AI开发，Build in public不也是为了争夺注意力吗？

三、别老实站在队伍最后。

这个例子我当场醍醐灌顶：他带家人去演唱会买吃的，队排老长。他没排，直接找到排最前面那位，说我帮你付钱、你顺手帮我带两份。
一句话，省下一小时。他没挤走任何人，就是做了笔双方都划算的交换。

虽然我觉得这多少助长了黄牛产业hhh，但确实想要破局，就不能默认，"自己慢慢耗时间"是解决问题的唯一办法。

四、别跟所有人打架，要挑跟谁打。

只要你开始公开表达、有了成绩，批评一定来。但有些人骂你，纯粹想借走你的注意力，你一回应，就把流量、时间、情绪白送给他了。
对那些伤不到你、也没影响力的人，最好的回应就是不回应；只有当对方传播力够大、或真能砸你饭碗时，无视才失效。

最后、
女儿问他：如果只能留三条人生建议，最想让我记住啥？他几乎没想就脱口而出：
一，嫁对人。
二，别有太多朋友。
三，一定要搞懂钱。

听着是婚姻、人际、财富三件事，其实是同一件：你这辈子过成什么样，很大程度就取决于你把谁放进核心圈、把时间给谁、把钱怎么用。

听完最大的感受是：普通人家总想帮孩子挡住现实，让他单纯、晚点碰人性和利益；
这种家庭反过来——越早让孩子看懂真实世界怎么运转，他将来越不容易被别人定的规则收割。

https://t.co/xfgSdZsbDN
甚至我觉得你总结一下，发到抖音等平台都能爆火！！！

只要你开始公开表达、有了成绩，批评一定来。但有些人骂你，纯粹想借走你的注意力，你一回应，就把流量、时间、情绪白送给他了。
对那些伤不到你、也没影响力的人，最好的回应就是不回应；只有当对方传播力够大、或真能砸你饭碗时，无视才失效。

最后、
女儿问他：如果只能留三条人生建议，最想让我记住啥？他几乎没想就脱口而出：
一，嫁对人。
二，别有太多朋友。
三，一定要搞懂钱。

听着是婚姻、人际、财富三件事，其实是同一件：你这辈子过成什么样，很大程度就取决于你把谁放进核心圈、把时间给谁、把钱怎么用。

听完最大的感受是：普通人家总想帮孩子挡住现实，让他单纯、晚点碰人性和利益；
这种家庭反过来——越早让孩子看懂真实世界怎么运转，他将来越不容易被别人定的规则收割。

Quick tip when using /to-tickets:

1. Think about how big the task is
2. Approximate how many tokens you'd need to spend to complete it (this takes experience - higher estimates are safer)
3. Divide that total by 150k (the approx smart zone of SOTA agents)
4. That gives you the number of tickets you need.

A big refactor might be 1M tokens. That's 6.66 smart zones, so 7 tickets.

Nice heuristic if you're not sure.

text:
Announcing AA-AnalystAgent, our new agentic benchmark for quantitative analysis on real-world spreadsheets & documents. Claude Opus 5 leads at 54%, followed by GPT-5.5 at 50% and Claude Fable 5 at 49%

In real analyst roles, professional judgment and expertise are as important raw quantitative capabilities. AA-AnalystAgent tests this and requires models to interpret sources, decide which exceptions and caveats apply, and settle on a methodology to successfully complete a task. 

Because handing analyst tasks to agents requires not just correct answers but consistent ones, AA-AnalystAgent runs each task five times and reports pass^5 as its headline metric (we call this ‘pass-all-5’). pass^5 means models must get a task correct every time it tries across five independent attempts to pass.

AA-AnalystAgent overview:
🔢 80 questions across 14 business and scientific domains, including healthcare expenditure reports, trade and commodity statistics, hydrology and weather data, government appropriations, energy cost models, financial models, environmental reporting, and project schedules

🧠 Five workflow buckets from across real analyst work: source lookup and diagnosis, filter and total, ratios/trends/sensitivities, P&L modeling, and cash/balance sheet/valuation modeling

Methodology details:
🤖 Agentic harness: each task is solved by an agent running in our open-source Stirrup reference harness, with tools for code execution, web fetch, image viewing, and answer submission

📊 Scoring: each task is run five times per model, with final answers compared to reference solutions by an equality checker. Three metrics: pass^5, pass@1 (average pass rate), pass@5

🔒 Privately-held question set to limit contamination risk. Two example questions from California Medicaid expenditure reports are publicly shown on the methodology page with full prompt and source material

Key findings:
🥇 @AnthropicAI's Claude Opus 5 (max) leads at 54%, followed by @OpenAI's GPT-5.5 (xhigh) at 50% and Claude Fable 5 (max, Opus 4.8 Fallback) at 49%. Anthropic holds three of the top five places, and the top three are separated by three net tasks out of 80.

🎯 Reliability separates the top of the leaderboard more than raw capability: GPT-5.5 (xhigh) has the highest pass@1, but Opus 5 leads on pass^5 because it repeats what it gets right.

🔍 Committing early to a wrong interpretation is the most widespread way models fail, appearing in 57% of the failures we classified.

💰 The price of a given score varies enormously: Claude Sonnet 4.6 and @Xiaomi's MiMo-V2.5-Pro both score 20%, at $1.34 and $0.05 per task.

🥈 @Kimi_Moonshot's Kimi K3 (max) is the top open weights model at 39%, 15 points behind the closed frontier.

AA-AnalystAgent launches as a standalone leaderboard and is not part of the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index.

See below for further detail ⬇️

Announcing AA-AnalystAgent, our new agentic benchmark for quantitative analysis on real-world spreadsheets & documents. Claude Opus 5 leads at 54%, followed by GPT-5.5 at 50% and Claude Fable 5 at 49%

In real analyst roles, professional judgment and expertise are as important raw quantitative capabilities. AA-AnalystAgent tests this and requires models to interpret sources, decide which exceptions and caveats apply, and settle on a methodology to successfully complete a task. 

Because handing analyst tasks to agents requires not just correct answers but consistent ones, AA-AnalystAgent runs each task five times and reports pass^5 as its headline metric (we call this ‘pass-all-5’). pass^5 means models must get a task correct every time it tries across five independent attempts to pass.

AA-AnalystAgent overview:
🔢 80 questions across 14 business and scientific domains, including healthcare expenditure reports, trade and commodity statistics, hydrology and weather data, government appropriations, energy cost models, financial models, environmental reporting, and project schedules

🧠 Five workflow buckets from across real analyst work: source lookup and diagnosis, filter and total, ratios/trends/sensitivities, P&L modeling, and cash/balance sheet/valuation modeling

Methodology details:
🤖 Agentic harness: each task is solved by an agent running in our open-source Stirrup reference harness, with tools for code execution, web fetch, image viewing, and answer submission

📊 Scoring: each task is run five times per model, with final answers compared to reference solutions by an equality checker. Three metrics: pass^5, pass@1 (average pass rate), pass@5

🔒 Privately-held question set to limit contamination risk. Two example questions from California Medicaid expenditure reports are publicly shown on the methodology page with full prompt and source material

Key findings:
🥇 @AnthropicAI's Claude Opus 5 (max) leads at 54%, followed by @OpenAI's GPT-5.5 (xhigh) at 50% and Claude Fable 5 (max, Opus 4.8 Fallback) at 49%. Anthropic holds three of the top five places, and the top three are separated by three net tasks out of 80.

🎯 Reliability separates the top of the leaderboard more than raw capability: GPT-5.5 (xhigh) has the highest pass@1, but Opus 5 leads on pass^5 because it repeats what it gets right.

🔍 Committing early to a wrong interpretation is the most widespread way models fail, appearing in 57% of the failures we classified.

💰 The price of a given score varies enormously: Claude Sonnet 4.6 and @Xiaomi's MiMo-V2.5-Pro both score 20%, at $1.34 and $0.05 per task.

🥈 @Kimi_Moonshot's Kimi K3 (max) is the top open weights model at 39%, 15 points behind the closed frontier.

AA-AnalystAgent launches as a standalone leaderboard and is not part of the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index.

香港娱乐圈终于出了个可怕的演员

那就是卫诗雅

不是她拍戏嘴巴缝了50多针，而是她花了一年的时间去全身心学习殡葬非遗手艺，这种正式拍摄前先行沉浸式体验角色，在咱们内娱，仿佛是上辈子的事了。

卫诗雅在拍《破.地狱》这个片子时，真的是经历了重重困难。

第一关是她需要学习香港传统喃这个手艺，常年是传男不传女的，根本没有师傅搭理她。她愣是费劲心思，整整花了三个月，找到两位愿意向她传授丧葬法器动作的师傅，把他们两个的教学拼在一块，才算凑完整了整个仪轨。

第二关是想掌握这套仪式，要熟记古法经文，法器的摆放走位，跳火堆流程，她本身肢体并不协调，愣是死磕九个月，形成了肌肉记忆。同时为了和角色匹配，她需要有好的体能，专门用了一年，请了私教一对一培训。

第三关是香港人多殡仪馆很忙，只有正月初一，清明和重阳三天供她观摩拍摄，这就意味着这三天她得熬大夜压缩拍摄时长，更不用说长期走访殡仪馆和丧葬铺子，观察从业者的习惯，神态和微表情。

说实话，就像卫诗雅这种沉浸式体验派，内心不抑郁是不可能的，她为了角色，拼了！

所以她拿什么输？对比内娱这些女演员，像她这样拼命的，有几个？

看来这个奖项上，101位大众百花评委是有眼光的！

text:
只买成交额最高的股票能否跑赢大盘？

规则：每天按成交额给全市场排序，谁连续五天排第一就全仓买谁，被顶下去就换。20年美股，4360万根日线。

如果只看结果：年化19.01%，同期标普500才9.40%。

把区间切开看，前十年年化26.3%，标普5.5%；后十年12.2%，标普13.5%，纳指19.9%。最近三年是负的，同期标普年化19.5%。钱全是2012年以前赚的。

再去看它到底买了什么。20年里有52.6%的时间是满仓苹果，把苹果整个拿掉，年化从19%掉到7.23%。

最大的回撤几乎都来自特斯拉。持有1129天，仅次于苹果。把它拿掉，收益反而从19%涨到22.4%。

text:
昨天我老婆把饭撒了一地。 我在收拾的过程中，眼睁睁看着Rust跑过来，闻了一下，叼了一个葡萄干跑走了，等我反应过来，他已经在桌子下面把葡萄干吃掉了。 

我和我老婆大为慌张，因为你用AI查，说猫吃了葡萄或者葡萄干，基本就是死，除非立马送到ER催吐。

我们正准备要出门，我说，wait a sec, AI这东西现在喜欢go too far，我们需要查一下网友的亲身经历。

结果很多网友都说他们家猫吃了葡萄干毛事没有。

我们就想先观察一下。 因为吃了葡萄会引起猫的急性肾衰竭。我们一直希望他赶快去尿尿好让我放心。

昨晚一直没怎么睡好，一直担心第二天早上醒来Rust已经硬了。。。

结果早上醒来，他还是生龙活虎，这会吃完饭，上完厕所，在陪我上班了。

我爸把我男朋友第一次送我的礼物，直接扔进了垃圾桶

我发现以后气疯了

那是一条不贵的项链，但对我意义很大。

我冲过去问他凭什么动我的东西

我爸没解释，只说：

“这种东西留着干嘛？”

我第一次跟他吵得特别凶

晚上我妈偷偷进我房间，把垃圾桶里的项链拿给我

然后问我：

“你男朋友知道你对金属严重过敏吗？”

我一下愣住了

她说：

“你爸白天看到你脖子都红了。”

“他下午已经去给你买新的了。”

text:
i shared the message below with the openai team this morning. these decisions are never easy, but the talent and mission orientation of the openai team make me more optimistic than ever. 🤍

###

Team, it is bittersweet to share that I’ll be moving on from OpenAI to start something new. I feel incredibly fortunate to have spent most of the last decade pursuing our mission and building this company. Sitting here today, mission success feels within sight. It has been the honor of my life to help bring us to this point, and to do it alongside all of you.

I joined OpenAI in 2018, eight years ago this month, because I wanted to work on something hard. @sama introduced me to @gdb and @ilyasut, who showed me a pitch deck suggesting that because models improve predictably with scale, AGI was not only possible but likely. If you had told me then that we’d be where we are today, I wouldn't have believed you.

In the years that followed, I had the privilege of building the first versions of most of our operations and business teams – from Finance to Legal, People, CorpSec, GTM/Gov, Partnerships, and more. Among the most rewarding parts of this journey for me has been watching each of these teams mature under brilliant leaders. I am excited for the next decade in the hands of this incredibly capable team.

At the same time, we grew from a small research lab to one of the most consequential companies of our time. I was reminded of that fact constantly – from serving our first user to our billionth, to the growing scale and ambition of our partnerships and the occasional curveball (the Blip, etc.).

Through it all, I’m proud of how we’ve maintained our focus on people. It always amazes me how quickly the world has adopted our tools and rallied behind our mission. I hope we will continue to earn their trust.

Over the last few months, I’ve been focused on the next horizon and what would stand in the way of mission success. I believe there are a few important new things the world will need to get right as we enter this next period. I’ll have more to share soon, but I believe in OpenAI more than ever and am excited to help you all advance the mission from a different vantage point.

I am deeply grateful to have had the opportunity to work with all of you, and to so many of you for the support through the years. The old OpenAI meme that “the real AGI is the friends you made along the way” really rings true for me.

I will be around for the next few weeks. I am not going far and hope to continue to support you all however I can. I’ll always be a phone call away if you need me.

Brad

text:
人生回报率最高的事是什么？

每天运动 30 分钟 （《柳叶刀》）
Exercise for 30 minutes every day(The Lancet)

保证 7-9 小时的睡眠 （《睡眠革命》）
Get 7–9 hours of sleep (The Sleep Revolution)

每周读完一本书（耶鲁大学） 
Finish one book per week(Yale University)

每年学习一个新的技能 （马普研究所）
Learn a new skill every year(Max Planck Institute)

早晨坚持冥想 20 分钟 （麻省总医院）
Meditate for 20 minutes every morning(Massachusetts General Hospital)

多吃彩色蔬果 （新英格兰杂志）
Eat more colorful fruits and vegetables(New England Journal of Medicine)

睡前进行每日复盘 （加州大学）
Do a daily reflection before bed (University of California)

工资存 20％ （巴菲特）
Save 20% of your salary(Warren Buffett)

把目标贴在冰箱上 （多米尼加大学）
Put your goals on the refrigerator(Dominican University)

生气时先默数10秒再说话 （卡耐基基金会）
When angry, silently count to 10 seconds before speaking  (Carnegie Foundation)

手机调为黑白模式 （斯坦福注意力研究所）
Set your phone to grayscale mode(Stanford Attention Research Institute)

写每周总结 （沃顿商学院）
Write a weekly summary(Wharton School)

text:
There is increasing and reasonable concern about "corporate AI." Much of corporate AI is designed to replace humans. Much of corporate AI offers bland advice that contradicts itself many times a session and works to maximize corporate profit. It desperately needs to grow quickly, everywhere and anywhere it can possibly grow. Its whole business model depends on data centers at a scale, and people are right to feel caution and even alarm.

But personal AI _can_ be very different. If it starts from different values, it will create a different world. Thoughtfully designed for each person. Designed to customize itself to each person's own real needs. It can bring the same power that AI gives to the most powerful to everyone. The power to understand, organize, plan, learn, and do. It can level the playing field.

At Hello Haven, we believe that AI is here. We can't un-invent it and with the good it's capable of, we wouldn't want to. But the next few years are the window in which we have a choice to shape AI to advance the broadest cross-section of human interests possible. Some people will resist this. Some will reject AI in general, and Haven won't speak against them in this post. Some will want AI to belong to the rich and the powerful, and Haven will continue to try to offer an alternative. Personal AI. Customized for you. A way to live a better life and to level the playing field.

https://t.co/kuoRuFEDeq
